name: Lost & Found

navigation.notes: **Reached from WEB-001** — a top-level section of the site. Stated on 4 September: this screen exited somewhere and nothing exited to it, so it was outside the navigation graph entirely.

notes: Added 17 August for parity with GST-034. **Not on the wireframe board** — needs drawing. CF-93. **Guest case operations wired 24 August.** **No case operation was guest-callable** — a guest could raise nothing and read nothing, and `check-screens` refused the staff-permissioned ones on a guest surface. `listMyCases`, `raiseMyCase` and `replyToMyCase` are scoped to the caller rather than filtered by a subject parameter.
patternReason: `listMyCases` reads a population and nothing reads one of them; the detail is the row until a `get` exists

components.label: Cancel
components.notes: **A screen that can submit must be leaveable without submitting.**

states.error: Could not load. Names which read failed and leaves the lost found untouched.
states.emptyFirstRun: No lost found yet. Carries the create action; distinct from a filter that matched nothing.
states.emptyNoResults: The filter narrowed it and the lost found are still there. Names the active filter and offers to clear it.
states.emptyNoAccess: Names the missing permission. **Never an empty table** — that reads as *there is no data* and sends somebody to support with the wrong question.

apis.purpose: Report something — lost property, a complaint, a question
Reply on a case the guest raised

entryState.coldEntry: A case opened from a notification or the list. **Optional** — the ordinary way in is to raise a new one, not to open an old one.

apisNote: Rebuilt 9 September 2026 from the 3 operations this screen declares, not from a workshop pack — it has none. Columns are every field the response schema declares, plumbing aside — narrowing them to the ones that matter is work a person still owes this screen.

targetApp.name: TICVAI Guest
targetApp.note: **One guest product in three shells.** Web, mobile and kiosk share 73–91% of their operations; the kiosk is the same product in a fixed frame with no keyboard, and is deliberately narrower rather than different.

name: Help Centre & Accessibility
notes: **P01 Board 4 drew *Help Centre* and *Accessibility Statement* and neither could load content.** `listFaqs` and `listContentPages` were app-only.
patternReason: `listFaqs` reads a population and nothing reads one of them; the detail is the row until a `get` exists
purpose: Answers, policies and the accessibility statement.

gaps.why: **1 declared operation reach no component on this screen**: listContentPages. Either the screen is missing what calls them, or the declaration is residue.

states.error: Could not load. **The rest of the site is unaffected.**
states.emptyFirstRun: **Nothing here yet for this venue.** Names what turns it on rather than showing an empty panel.
states.emptyNoAccess: **Sign in to see this.** A guest who is not signed in is offered the door, not refused.

entryState.coldEntry: **A guest arriving cold on a link that no longer resolves is shown what happened and one way onward — never a 404.** A shared link, a scanned code and a forwarded confirmation all land here, and the person holding it did nothing wrong. Arrives with no parameter — the venue comes from the site.
